title: ceratopteris siliquosa
intro: Ceratopteris siliquosa, commonly known as water sprite, is a type of aquatic fern native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Ceratopteris siliquosa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
